description: Dark-band width and share of the visible length that is not unclear of the 30 cases (6 viewpoints x 5 mean openings; one image per case, clear sky, sun elevation 40 degrees). points: one row per case. width_ratio = dark-band width / geometric opening, both in pixels; discernible_share = 1 - U length / visible length of the joints.
paper_items: supplement S4: apparent width, gaps and the trace length retained in the labels, first paragraph

units.segment: lt3: geometric opening below 3 px; gt10: above 10 px; mid: between

input_checks.name: I2 the 30 cases are frames of the formal label set
I4 opening and illumination as stated
I5 the 5 openings of a viewpoint share the camera, the sun azimuth and the other shape parameters

record_only.note: Not used in the manuscript: values per viewpoint, Spearman correlation of the 5 cases of a viewpoint, least-squares slope of the dark-band width against the geometric opening, Spearman correlation for flat and standalone outcrops separately, and the fraction of unclear windows.

fault_pixels.note: At the two coarse flat-outcrop viewpoints (scene 26120005, plan cameras c2 and c3) the final centreline holds fault-trace pixels. The dark-band width record is the median over all centreline pixels, so the dark-band width of these two viewpoints is the median over joint and fault pixels together, and the fault trace does not change with the opening of the joints. The clear fraction is taken from per_type.joint and holds joints only. The same width measurement is run again here: its result on all pixels is checked against the record, then the median is taken over the joint pixels (source_type 1).

ruler_recheck.tolerance: medians within 1e-9 px; same number of samples, same share without dark band, same number of samples at the profile end

notes: All values come from one fixed illumination per viewpoint (clear sky, sun elevation 40 degrees) and the untextured material, one image per case.
Viewpoints with fault pixels in the final centreline: flat 13.54, flat 19.39 (30.8%-38.7% of its pixels); the 5 cases with a geometric opening below 3 px all come from flat 13.54, flat 19.39.
